overloadPatches.semanticRole: Returns the first subsection intersected by a range or element passed in targetObj; returns a null object if no subsection intersects it.
Returns the subsection of the specified subSectionType (wk first page, wk left page, or wk right page) within wpSection.

constraints: If targetObj is or belongs to a header, footer, or text box, the command returns the subsection to which it is attached (or a null object if it is not attached to any subsection).
